newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DB's Corbans says new brand sales strong.
newsitem.headline: DB's Corbans says new brand sales strong.

text.p: Corbans Wines Chief Executive Noel Scanlan said on Monday the company had sold its entire pre-Christmas supply of its new brand, Verde, to the trade less than two months since its launch.

"We've sold everything to the licensed trade that we can sell prior to Christmas," Scanlan said. Corbans still had stock left but the "methode traditionelle" method meant it could not be released before the year's end, he told Reuters.

Scanlan said the trade had reported empty shelves soon after the Air New Zealand Wine Awards early this month, where Verde won the top prize. It had earlier been given a five star rating by Cuisine magazine and a recommendation from Metro magazine.
Verde, a blend of Hawkes Bay-grown pinot noir and chardonnay, was pitched at NZ$15 a bottle because of a perceived gap in the market place, Scanlan said.
Corbans is a unit of DB Group Ltd.
